A focused negative control proves that a forbidden field in the Insights fixture is rejected; no validator policy, fixture bytes or test skip is relaxed.
Focused fixture-security and documentation checks pass; the bounded diff is self-reviewed and committed, with native reruns and unrelated release qualification retained as coordinator obligations.

The release notes contain the complete approved public key, full fingerprint, exact export digest and concise import/detached-verification instructions; package manifests and asset guards remain unchanged.

The agent canary fixture declares only its actual standard/platform dependencies; the exact two-name child environment assertion and production profile remain intact, with focused native fixture evidence and matching integration reruns handed to the coordinator.

The captured native Windows failures are repaired without relaxing CRT handling, CNG stub behavior, private scratch security or workbench assertions, and affected native targets build/test against the exact committed candidate.
The resident Help test matches the accepted complete action order, retains windowless disabled-state assertions and changes no product UX.
Pinned HACL generated C compiles under strict C11 on Ubuntu26.04 with only its private Linux feature definition; affected SHA-256 contracts pass without global flags or pin/upstream changes.

All14 pending Windows exemptions are grounded in actual direct/contained observations, reproduced portability failures are corrected, and exact finite pins plus mandatory native manifest pass without relaxed assertions, deadlines or network grants.

The actual Mac history input-gap failure is diagnosed and a justified candidate passes focused native evidence under unchanged platform budgets and attributed timing semantics; required baseline/reproduction evidence remains explicit until supplied.

The approved macOS Insights application-menu command remains exactly one across workbench sibling, settings, last-window close and reopen, dispatches to the active profile and is disabled without a window; no owner live desktop is driven by the implementer.
The two actual GCC15 range-loop-construct errors bind their workbench entry/id pairs by const reference, preserving callbacks and warnings-as-errors, with focused compile evidence.
The actual Linux metadata harness compile failure uses the platform stat nanosecond timestamp member without reducing snapshot fidelity.
